calibration.title: Portrait focus calibration (development only)
calibration.hint: Click or drag the head anchor on the complete source canvas, or edit X / Y / scale. The preview uses the production card. Switching characters keeps page drafts; reloading discards changes that have not been exported.
calibration.install: Export includes all configuration. Replace src/tools/warp-simulator/data/portrait-focus.json with the downloaded portrait-focus.json, then run npm run type-check and npm test -- tests/unit/warp-simulator/portrait-calibration.test.ts. Images need not be regenerated.
calibration.invalid: Invalid parameters: X and Y must be between 0 and 1; scale must be between 0.1 and 8. The last valid value is retained.
calibration.canvas: Complete portrait: click or drag to position, or use the numeric inputs above
calibration.unavailable: Image unavailable. Select another character or check the assets.
